statement: Cerebras launched the CS-4 wafer-scale system, claiming more than 4,400 tokens per second per user on GPT-OSS-120B and up to 30 times the per-user speed of GPU solutions, with first shipments in Q3 2026.
why: A shipping non-GPU inference system with a large claimed latency advantage is a live alternative to merchant GPUs for interactive inference workloads.

impact.mechanism: Wafer-scale systems shipping this quarter add non-GPU inference capacity aimed at latency-sensitive serving of open-weight models, competing for inference workloads that would otherwise run on merchant GPUs.

evidence.source: Cerebras Systems (GlobeNewswire press release, reprinted by Manila Times)
evidence.excerpt: more than 4,400 tokens second per user (TPS/user), up to 30 times faster than GPU solutions.

evidence.source: Cerebras Systems (GlobeNewswire press release, reprinted by Manila Times)
evidence.excerpt: First CS-4 shipments begin this quarter

confidence.basis: Vendor press release distributed over a wire and reprinted; benchmark claims are self-reported with no independent verification and the reprint is syndication of one story, not multi-publisher corroboration.
